final_operational_negatives.observed: The first post-evidence fresh-live projection applied the split operator inside the Git invocation and reduced the returned hash to a single letter, creating a false inequality signal.
final_operational_negatives.recovery: Assign the complete ls-remote line to a scalar first, split that scalar on the tab delimiter, and compare the resulting hash without replaying the push.
final_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Separate remote command execution from PowerShell parsing whenever an operator could be consumed as a native-command argument.

final_operational_negatives.observed: The first bulk closeout domain rewrite embedded mojibake arrow text in a PowerShell replacement chain and failed at parse time without editing the file.
final_operational_negatives.recovery: Use a bounded UTF-8 mechanical rewrite with explicit Unicode escape sequences, then inspect every remaining stale label before generation.
final_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Do not place mojibake or non-ASCII replacement tokens directly inside a PowerShell chained-method expression.

final_operational_negatives.observed: A densely escaped composite rg audit was split into invalid Windows path arguments and returned no trustworthy stale-label result.
final_operational_negatives.recovery: Run several short literal or simple-regex searches over the single closeout file and review each result set independently.
final_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Keep Windows stale-label audits below the shell's quoting complexity threshold.

final_operational_negatives.observed: A Python probe launched from a PowerShell here-string received its non-ASCII mojibake tokens as question marks and falsely labeled four regex-bearing scripts.
final_operational_negatives.recovery: Reject the false signal, retain it at zero credit, and use literal rg scans plus ASCII-escaped Python output under an explicit UTF-8 environment.
final_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Do not pass non-ASCII diagnostic sentinel literals through an encoding-ambiguous PowerShell here-string.

final_operational_negatives.observed: A combined Git status, revision, branch, and correction-template metadata probe timed out before returning output in the large worktree.
final_operational_negatives.recovery: Inspect running Git processes and concrete lock files first, then split the revision, branch, tracked-state, and template reads into bounded literal probes.
final_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Do not combine an unbounded untracked status walk with unrelated metadata reads in a large Windows worktree.
